name: Bharti Hexacom Ltd
title: Bharti Hexacom Ltd - 544162 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Hexacom Q4 FY26 shows steady telecom operating leverage (47.9% margin, 148k homes net adds) but ARPU is soft (Rs.252 reported, ~Rs.257-258 EDB) and capex is stepping up to Rs.586 Cr in the quarter.

capex.peers_comment: Parent says radio capex is moderating in India and core capex is moderated; FWA cost pressure from chipset and memory prices.
capex.quote: Capex for the quarter was Rs.586 Crores. Acceleration was as planned

triggers.label: ARPU Rs.252, EDB ~Rs.257-258
triggers.quote: ARPU for the quarter was Rs. 2 52, impacted by two days less, whilst on an EDB basis, it would be cl oser to about Rs. 257 to Rs. 258.

triggers.quote: Capex for the quarter was Rs.586 Crores.

guidance.quote: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs.18 per share as compared to Rs.10 per share last year
